== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Ord Mantell (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[Ord Mantell (PC Errata 2013 slip)]]. The 2013 slip and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>d7fbb2808bfec4eb1c66a079002186b19c92f21c</code>.

Fair use rationale: crops of copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card images, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee), used only to show the differences between versions on this non-commercial fan wiki.
